title: Linkivo — Smart Link Manager
tagline: Discover, Manage, and Explore Links with Intelligence
short_description: A progressive web app for intelligent link management with weighted discovery system, GSAP animations, and Firebase backend.
long_description: Linkivo is a sophisticated smart link management Progressive Web Application built with modern web technologies. The application features a Firebase-backed architecture with real-time database integration, custom client-side routing implemented in vanilla JavaScript, and advanced UI animations powered by GSAP. Features include a cinematic splash screen with narrative animation (link cards converging into a padlock), weighted point system for random link discovery, secure PIN-based authentication with DOM-hiding protection, and a comprehensive sidebar system with logo-as-toggle functionality. The app implements intelligent caching, duplicate prevention, and a multi-layered website preview fallback system supporting iframe, OG thumbnails, screenshot API, and favicon extraction.
content:
Overview

Linkivo is Turzo's most sophisticated active project — a Smart Link Management PWA built purely with Vanilla JavaScript, Firebase, and GSAP animations. No frameworks, no shortcuts.

Technical Highlights

  • Custom SPA architecture with event-driven client-side routing
  • GSAP cinematic splash screen: link cards converge into an auto-locking padlock
  • Firebase RTDB for real-time persistence across sessions
  • PIN-lock security using HTML inert attribute + visibility:hidden for DOM-level hiding
  • Weighted discovery algorithm surfaces links based on assigned point values

Multi-layer Website Preview

The preview system cascades through multiple fallback layers: iframe embed → Open Graph thumbnail → Screenshot API → Favicon extraction. This ensures some form of visual preview for virtually any URL.

Architecture

No build tools. No bundlers. Pure browser APIs, carefully structured into modules. This constraint pushed deeper mastery of JavaScript fundamentals — custom event system, memory-safe cache invalidation, and DOM encapsulation without a virtual DOM.

long_description: Project Exporter Pro is an open-source, self-contained JavaScript export engine designed to handle multiple output formats including PNG, JPG, WebP, SVG, PDF, and CMYK color space exports. content:
Overview

Project Exporter Pro is an open-source, zero-dependency JavaScript export engine that adds multi-format export capability to any web application — without any style conflicts.

Shadow DOM Isolation

The entire widget lives inside a Shadow DOM boundary. Host page styles cannot leak in; widget styles cannot leak out. True encapsulation — the only reliable way to build genuinely portable web components.

Supported Formats

PNG · JPG · WebP · SVG · PDF · CMYK

API

ExporterPro.export({
  format: 'png',
  quality: 0.95,
  element: document.querySelector('#target')
})

Clean, intuitive, plug-and-play. Embeds into any project with a single <script> tag.

A Google Sheet acts as a CMS. Each row represents a notification with fields for title, message, date, type, and URL. Google Apps Script exposes the sheet as a public JSON endpoint. The frontend fetches this data and renders it as a styled, filterable notification panel.

title: QR Prism
tagline: Generate, Scan, and Manage QR Codes with Professional Features
short_description: Feature-rich Progressive Web App for generating, scanning, and managing QR codes with batch processing, cloud storage, and admin panel.
long_description: QR Prism is a comprehensive QR code solution built as a Progressive Web Application. Supports multiple QR generation types (text, URL, vCard, WiFi), batch processing from CSV/TXT/JSON files with ZIP export, built-in camera scanner with overlay UI, and Firebase-backed user profiles with ImgBB image upload. Implements three-tier Service Worker caching (Cache-First, Network-First, Stale-While-Revalidate) for offline support. Admin panel uses SHA-256 hashing with Firebase DB role verification. Architecture evolved from Canvas rendering (v2.7) to SVG-based rendering (v3.4) for improved performance.
content:
Overview

QR Prism is a comprehensive QR code solution built as a Progressive Web Application. It went through major architectural evolution — from Canvas-based rendering in v2.7 to a cleaner SVG-based approach in v3.4.

Core Features

  • Batch Generation: Drag-and-drop CSV/TXT/JSON → ZIP download via JSZip
  • Scanner: CSS overlay with type-based action buttons (URL, email, phone)
  • Profile System: ImgBB image upload integration for avatars
  • Report System: Messenger-style feedback reports

Security Architecture

The admin panel uses SHA-256 hashing with Firebase Database role verification (admins/{uid}: true) — server-side enforcement, not just client-side checks. This was redesigned from an earlier approach that relied only on local state.

PWA & Offline

Three-tier Service Worker caching strategy ensures the app works offline. Install it on Android or desktop — it behaves like a native app.
